name: @frank/codec
description: Browser-safe TypeScript reference codec for Frank deterministic CBOR v1 (docs/protocol/cbor): FRNK frame encode/parse, restricted canonical-CBOR encode/validate, section 9 stages 1-10 (stage 10.6: algorithm-1 directory signatures), T1/T1a content hashes. Used by explicit CBOR registration and opt-in topics; other record families are not wired to normal production paths.

scripts.check:browser: node browsercheck/build.js && node browsercheck/check-vm.js && node browsercheck/check-chrome.js
